description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Disconnect a SIP trunk

Removes a number you connected yourself from EchoCall and from its agent. The number stays with your carrier. Only such numbers of your own account.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: delete_sip_trunk
title: Disconnect a SIP trunk
